properties.description: Synchronous reset clears both response valids after its edge and cancels queued obligations. After 128 consecutive reset-free, no-offer, both-ready edges, tracked input and both response queues must be drained.
A blocked data presentation retains valid, data and last across each following edge, unless that edge resets the controller.
A blocked status presentation retains valid and all status fields across each following edge, unless that edge resets the controller.

Every valid data presentation, including blocked presentations, must match the next accepted input byte or justified completed-frame zero padding. Frames remain ordered and only their first eight input bytes are retained.

Every valid data presentation has last exactly at the final byte of the frame length clamped to four through eight. Partial accepted prefixes cannot terminate before byte eight; unjustified or excess beats fail.

Every valid status describes the next completed accepted input frame with exact original length, clamped output length, padding flag and truncation flag. Status consumption is tracked independently of data consumption; neither channel is required to complete first.
